# Overview and quick start {#sec-ch01}

kintera computes the thermodynamics, phase and chemical equilibrium, kinetics, photochemistry and diffusion of a
mixture of gases and condensates, on CPU or GPU, as `torch` operations that a model can call cell by cell. This
chapter is a map and a first run. It says where in this report each part of the code is described, how to install
kintera, and how to make one call that you can check against a recorded output. It does not summarize the other
chapters; follow their labels for the content.
